clauses.quote: The District shall provide a summary of accumulated sick leave to all unit members.
Sick days may be used by a unit member for personal illness, injury, physical disability, or quarantine.
Beginning with July 1, 2000, a unit member may annually use six (6) sick leave days for the illness of a child, parent, or spouse.

After accrued sick days are exhausted, and if a unit member is absent from duties because of illness or accident for a period of 100 duty days or less, the amount deducted from the salary due for any month in which the absence occurred shall not exceed the sum which is normally paid a substitute employee.
clauses.subject_text: the amount deducted from the salary due for any month in which the absence occurred
clauses.notes: Conditional limitation on management's authority to deduct salary during extended sick leave.

clauses.quote: All sick day benefits must be claimed within each payroll reporting period by filing a unit member absence card.
Signature certification of the unit member is required for absences not exceeding six (6) consecutive duty days.
clauses.subject_text: Signature certification of the unit member
clauses.notes: No modal verb; uses 'is required' to impose procedural duty.

clauses.quote: If a pattern of absences exists or if there is reasonable cause to believe that the unit member is abusing the use of sick days, the Human Resources Office may require the unit member to provide additional certification of such absences.
clauses.notes: Discretionary authority granted to management upon reasonable suspicion of abuse.

clauses.quote: A written statement of absence day(s) and reason(s) for absence by a duly licensed physician for absences more than six (6) consecutive duty days, or acceptable evidence of treatment and the need therefore by the practitioner of the religion of any well-recognized church or denomination, shall be required in each payroll reporting period.
clauses.subject_text: A written statement of absence day(s) and reason(s) for absence by a duly licensed physician for absences more than six (6) consecutive duty days, or acceptable evidence of treatment and the need therefore by the practitioner of the religion of any well-recognized church or denomination
clauses.notes: Long subject; imposes duty on worker to submit medical or religious documentation.

clauses.quote: The absence card shall indicate the days of absence, the reason(s) for the absence(s), and the unit member's signature.
The immediate supervisor's signature designating approval is required in order for the unit member to receive pay.
clauses.subject_text: The immediate supervisor's signature designating approval
clauses.notes: No modal; establishes procedural condition for pay authorization.

clauses.quote: The District shall provide each unit member with verification of accumulated sick days by November 1.
